description.en: The type of the protection rule.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看您当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of your current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh:
要查询规则对应的防护对象。
> 仅当 **DefenseType** 为 **resource** 时，需要传入该参数。
description.en:
The protected object associated with the rule to query.
> This parameter is required only when **DefenseType** is set to **resource**.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
The ID of the protection rule to query.

description.zh:
要查询的防护模板ID。
> 仅当 **DefenseType** 为 **template** 时，需要传入该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the protection template to query.
> This parameter is required only when **DefenseType** is set to **template**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-rule --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 10318 --rule-id 20026192 --defense-type template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --resource rencs000-waf --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeDefenseRule --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RuleId 20026192 --Resource 'rencs000-waf' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DefenseType template --TemplateId 10318
